serviceIdentification.serviceName: Minsky No-code ML/NLP Knowledge Graphing Platform
serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Minsky No-code ML/NLP Knowledge Graphing Platform
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Minsky No-code ML/NLP Knowledge Graphing Platform allows analysts to create personalized ML agents that continuously scan large PAI/CAI datasets on their behalf. Minsky identifies and extracts entities, actions, and flashpoints relevant to the analyst's AoR. Minsky learns from each analyst in order to deliver answers that align with the SMEs' understanding of threat network behavior, sidestepping the need for technical middlemen and radically reducing the flash to bang of data science. Minsky operates in all DoD priority languages, ensuring that non-technical SMEs can track global threat networks, identify risk in supply chains, perform literature and budgetary review, and analyze other text data of their choosing.
